title: Rethinking Representations for World-Action Modeling
abstract: World-action models jointly learn robot policies and predict future observations, making the representation space an interface between control and prediction. We study the design of this space through controlled comparisons, finding that neither reconstruction fidelity nor pre-trained perceptual features alone ensure effective policy learning. These findings motivate ReWAM, a representation-centric world-action model built on pre-trained DINO features. Feature Calibration and a Temporal Representation Bottleneck organize these features into compact world states suited to dynamics modeling. Action-Grounded Representation Shaping routes only action-loss gradients to the bottleneck, thereby letting the policy shape what the representation encodes while the world model learns how it evolves. Without generative video pre-training, ReWAM achieves 93.6% success on RoboTwin 2.0. On RoboDojo, it achieves an average score of 12.29 and a success rate of 8.28% using approximately 600 hours of embodied pre-training data.

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: In a graduate course on robot learning and world models, today’s lecture is on ReWAM, a representation-centered approach to world-action modeling. Recent work such as JEPA-WAM and OpenWAM reflects a broader trend: robots should learn not only to choose actions, but also to model how scenes change. ReWAM asks how those goals can share a visual representation without competing to shape it in the same way. This matters because a robot needs useful information, not just a detailed picture. Yes, Noah?
segments.zh: 在一门关于机器人学习和世界模型的研究生课程上，今天的讲座讲的是ReWAM，一种以表征为中心的世界-动作建模方法。最近像JEPA-WAM和OpenWAM这样的工作反映了一个更广泛的趋势：机器人不仅要学会选择动作，还要学会对场景如何变化进行建模。ReWAM要问的是，这两个目标如何能共享同一个视觉表征，而不是以同样的方式争相塑造它。这一点很重要，因为机器人需要的是有用的信息，而不只是一张详细的图景。好，Noah，你有什么问题？

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hi Professor, when you say a detailed picture might not help, do you mean reconstruction can distract from control?
segments.zh: 教授您好，您说详细的画面可能没什么用，是指重建会干扰控制吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That is the tension. A representation trained to reconstruct every visible detail may preserve information that does little for deciding what to do. A compact state designed for control, though, still needs to support predictions about how the scene evolves. ReWAM’s proposal is to let the action objective shape that state, while a separate world-model objective learns transitions within it. Its main RoboTwin result is 93.6% success in random scenes, compared with 92.2% for AHA-WAM, without generative video pre-training.
segments.zh: 这就是矛盾所在。一个被训练来重建所有可见细节的表征，可能会保留一些对决定该做什么几乎没用的信息。但一个为控制而设计的紧凑状态，仍然需要支持对场景如何演变的预测。ReWAM 的方案是让动作目标来塑造这个状态，同时用一个独立的世界模型目标来学习其中的状态转移。它在 RoboTwin 上的主要结果是随机场景中 93.6% 的成功率，相比之下 AHA-WAM 是 92.2%，而且没有用生成式视频预训练。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The authors first test whether visual reconstruction quality predicts control quality. In a matched RoboTwin comparison without generative video pre-training, W-A-M features based on frozen dino features outperform video V-A-E latents by 4.90 percentage points on clean scenes and 9.22 points on random scenes. Yet the dino features have lower RGB reconstruction SSIM: 0.70 versus 0.91. In this experiment, better pixel reconstruction did not mean better control; that result does not show reconstruction is never useful.
segments.zh: 作者先检验了视觉重建质量能否预测控制质量。在一次匹配的RoboTwin对比中，没有生成式视频预训练的情况下，基于冻结dino特征的W-A-M特征在干净场景上比视频V-A-E潜变量高出4.90个百分点，在随机场景上高出9.22个百分点。但dino特征的RGB重建SSIM更低：0.70对0.91。在这个实验里，更好的像素重建并不意味着更好的控制；这个结果并不能说明重建永远没用。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Quick question: what does ReWAM change before it trains the action policy?
segments.zh: 快速问一下：ReWAM在训练动作策略之前改了什么？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: It calibrates the visual features and then compresses them into a compact representation. Feature Calibration combines information across dino layers, normalizes the features, and adjusts the diffusion noise schedule for the target size. Together, those steps add 12.20 percentage points in average RoboTwin success over raw dino features. A trainable Temporal Representation Bottleneck, or T-R-B, then organizes features from neighboring frames into compact tokens, giving the action and world branches a shared state to work with.
segments.zh: 它先校准视觉特征，再把它们压缩成一个紧凑的表示。特征校准会融合dino各层的信息，对特征做归一化，并针对目标尺寸调整扩散噪声调度。这些步骤合在一起，让RoboTwin的平均成功率比原始dino特征高出12.20个百分点。接着，一个可训练的时间表示瓶颈，也就是T-R-B，会把相邻帧的特征组织成紧凑的token，为动作分支和世界分支提供一个共享的状态来使用。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The central design is called A-G-R-S, or Action-Grounded Representation Shaping. During joint training, action-loss gradients pass through the current representation and can adjust the bottleneck. World-prediction-loss gradients stop at the current and future representations instead. The world model therefore learns how states transition, while the action objective shapes what the state should preserve. Think of it as letting one learner tune the map for decisions while another studies movement across that map.
segments.zh: 核心设计叫A-G-R-S，也就是动作锚定表征塑造。联合训练时，动作损失的梯度会穿过当前表征，并能调整瓶颈。而世界预测损失的梯度则止步于当前和未来的表征。因此，世界模型学习的是状态如何转移，而动作目标塑造的是状态应该保留什么。可以把它理解为让一个学习器为决策调整地图，同时让另一个学习器研究在这张地图上的移动。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Can you clarify whether the robot predicts future states while it is acting?
segments.zh: 你能澄清一下，机器人在行动时是否会预测未来状态吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: No. ReWAM trains a branch to predict future representations, but at inference it processes the current state to condition action generation; it does not generate future states then. The gradient-routing ablation tests whether this distinction matters. With A-G-R-S, one-epoch RoboTwin success is 90.70% on clean scenes and 89.12% on random scenes. Allowing world-loss gradients through the current representation lowers those results to 84.32% and 82.90%; routing gradients through both current and future representations degrades performance further.
segments.zh: 不是。ReWAM 会训练一个分支来预测未来的表征，但在推理时，它处理的是当前状态，用来为动作生成提供条件；它并不会在那时生成未来状态。梯度路由的消融实验检验的就是这一区别是否重要。在 A-G-R-S 下，单轮 RoboTwin 在干净场景中的成功率为 90.70%，在随机场景中为 89.12%。如果允许世界损失梯度通过当前表征回传，这两个结果会降到 84.32% 和 82.90%；而让梯度同时通过当前和未来表征回传，性能会进一步下降。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Those ablations use a matched one-epoch budget, unlike the five-epoch main comparison. The authors suggest that world-loss gradients could encourage representation collapse or predictive shortcuts, but those are hypotheses, not mechanisms directly established by the experiment. For the main RoboTwin evaluation, success is averaged over 50 tasks, with 100 episodes per task in each setting. Keeping these protocols separate matters: it prevents us from treating the ablation numbers as though they were measured under the same training budget as the headline comparison.
segments.zh: 这些消融实验用的是一轮训练的预算，跟主实验的五轮对比不一样。作者提出，世界损失梯度可能会导致表征坍缩或者走预测捷径，但这些都只是假设，实验并没有直接证明其中的机制。主实验的RoboTwin评估里，成功率是在50个任务上取平均，每个任务在每种设定下跑100条轨迹。把这两套实验方案分开看很重要：这样我们就不会把消融实验的数字当成是在跟主对比相同的训练预算下测出来的。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So is the key claim that the action objective should always control the representation?
segments.zh: 那么关键主张是不是动作目标应该始终控制表征呢？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The evidence supports a narrower claim: in these controlled comparisons, the routing design that lets action loss shape the current representation performs better than the tested alternatives. It does not establish that the world model contributes nothing to representation learning, or that this division is optimal for every robot task. On RoboDojo, after approximately 600 hours of embodied pre-training, ReWAM reports a mean partial-progress score of 12.29 and a mean binary success rate of 8.28%, averaged across five capability categories.
segments.zh: 这些证据支持的其实是一个更窄的结论：在这些受控对比中，让动作损失塑造当前表征的路由设计，比所测试的其他方案表现更好。它并不能证明世界模型对表征学习毫无贡献，也不能说明这种分工对每个机器人任务都是最优的。在RoboDojo上，经过大约600小时的具身预训练后，ReWAM在五个能力类别上的平均部分进展得分为12.29，平均二值成功率为8.28%。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That RoboDojo average also has an important boundary: Open instruction following is a weakness. The authors attribute the gap to the lack of generative video pre-training, so the aggregate result should not be read as strong performance in every category. ReWAM extends a representation-centered direction also seen in Fast-WAM, which retains video co-training but skips future-video denoising at deployment. ReWAM’s distinct contribution is to specify how action and world-prediction objectives shape a shared state.
segments.zh: 这个RoboDojo平均值还有一个重要边界：开放指令跟随是弱项。作者把这一差距归因于缺少生成式视频预训练，所以这个总体结果不应被解读为在每个类别上都表现强劲。ReWAM延续了Fast-WAM中也出现的以表征为中心的方向，后者保留了视频协同训练，但在部署时跳过了未来视频去噪。ReWAM的独特贡献在于明确了动作目标和世界预测目标如何塑造一个共享状态。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: How should this influence future world-action models, given the instruction-following limitation?
segments.zh: 考虑到指令遵循方面的局限，这应如何影响未来的世界-动作模型？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: It suggests that researchers should evaluate representations by their usefulness to both control and prediction, rather than relying on reconstruction metrics alone. It also makes gradient routing a testable design choice: future work can compare alternative ways of sharing information between action and world objectives, across tasks and training conditions. At the same time, ReWAM’s RoboDojo weakness cautions that representation shaping does not automatically provide broad instruction generalization. Results here motivate further tests; they do not settle a universal recipe.
segments.zh: 这说明研究者评估表征时，应该看它对控制和预测是否都有用，而不是只看重建指标。它也让梯度路由成为一个可检验的设计选择：未来工作可以比较动作目标和世界目标之间共享信息的不同方式，并覆盖多种任务和训练条件。与此同时，ReWAM 在 RoboDojo 上的弱点也提醒我们，表征塑造并不会自动带来广泛的指令泛化能力。这里的结果能推动更多测试，但并没有给出一个通用的万能配方。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The takeaway is that a robot’s internal state can serve two jobs without giving both training objectives identical influence over it. ReWAM’s results favor a state shaped by action learning while the world model learns its dynamics, with the evidence bounded by the tested settings and its instruction-following weakness. Two jobs, distinct signals: that is the design principle to carry forward. Thanks for listening. If you have any further questions, ask our AI assistant or drop a comment.
segments.zh: 结论是，机器人的内部状态可以同时承担两项任务，而不必让两个训练目标对它施加完全相同的影响。ReWAM 的结果支持这样一种状态：它由动作学习塑造，而世界模型则学习其动态，这一证据受限于所测试的设定及其指令跟随方面的弱点。两项任务，不同信号：这就是值得沿用的设计原则。感谢收听。如果还有任何问题，可以询问我们的 AI 助手或留言评论。
